species: This study utilized left ventricular (LV) myocardium from 105 non-failing (NF) and failing human hearts.
tissue: Proteomic analysis of left ventricle tissue reveals a consistent upregulation and stabilization of intermediate filaments and MTs in failing human hearts.
cell_type: Here we utilize mass spectrometry and single-myocyte mechanical assays to characterize changes to the cardiomyocyte cytoskeleton and their functional consequences in human heart failure.
disease_state: This study utilized left ventricular (LV) myocardium from 105 non-failing (NF) and failing human hearts.
sample_source: Non-failing (NF) hearts were obtained at the time of organ donation from cadaveric donors.
